title.value: Forgetting at biologically realistic levels of neurogenesis in a large-scale hippocampal model

title.quote: Forgetting at biologically realistic levels of neurogenesis in a large-scale hippocampal model

analysis.description: This paper explores the effect of neurogenesis on forgetting in a large-scale hippocampal model. By incorporating a more realistic number of neurons and network features into an artificial neural network, the authors investigate how new neuron properties impact memory and forgetting. Their findings reveal that neurogenesis can induce forgetting in larger networks at lower rates than previously thought, with implications for understanding memory dynamics.
